# Copyright notices and conditional OFL evidence for 217 font files

The [89 exact-byte source matches](verified-source-map.json) remain distinct from the [128 conditional OFL applicability records](unresolved-source-map.json). This notice preserves their original embedded copyright; it does not clear all presentation assets or change the controlled rights inventory.

## Distribution and modification conditions

The full upstream license texts control; this summary does not replace them.

- Include the applicable copyright notice and complete OFL with copies. Font software cannot be sold by itself.
- Modified, subset or converted font software remains under OFL; do not apply the project's MIT license to it.
- A modified primary font name may not use a Reserved Font Name without the corresponding permission. These mapped binaries do not declare an RFN in their retained copyright strings; this observation is not permission to ignore an applicable upstream RFN.
- Do not use copyright-holder or author names to promote modified fonts except as the license permits.
- The OFL does not apply to documents merely created using the fonts.

The retained unresolved-source-map filename describes historical distribution-lineage limits, not a blanket lack of permission. OFL permits modified/subset/converted fonts subject to its conditions; exact matching to today's upstream bytes is not required. Independent review supported this conditional interpretation, not absolute rights clearance.

A website/export that copies the font directory must also copy the relevant notices and mapping; placing these files in the source repository alone does not prove any separately built export includes them.

### Manrope — six files
Original embedded notice: Copyright 2019 The Manrope Project Authors (https://github.com/sharanda/manrope)

The [retained official OFL](Manrope-OFL.txt) additionally preserves: Copyright 2018 The Manrope Project Authors (https://github.com/googlefonts/manrope).

Version 4.504 and its exact historical release/acquisition chain remain unverified. Official Google Fonts metadata identifies Mikhail Sharanda and the same project under OFL; this supports conditional applicability, not an exact-release-verification claim. No specific RFN was found in inspected notices. Preserve both attributions and the provenance limitation.

All groups remain subject to the conditions above and the full controlling license texts. These additions do not clear unknown C17 materials or establish complete repository-wide rights.

## Manrope 4.504 historical OFL corroboration (2026-11-08)

The earlier Manrope assessment above is supplemented, not replaced, by the
[official Google Fonts 4.504 update](https://github.com/google/fonts/pull/3642/files)
and its [commit-pinned full OFL](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/google/fonts/d5bee0d9645512aa817f47efdd2d54f415345f3c/ofl/manrope/OFL.txt),
retained byte-for-byte as [Manrope-4.504-OFL.txt](Manrope-4.504-OFL.txt)
(4,384 bytes; SHA-256
`e01b637272e0cbdfb240184dd98ea5cc671556d9894dae2668d92ab2c906787c`).
The historical notice reads: Copyright 2018 The Manrope Project Authors
(https://github.com/sharanda/manrope). Preserve it alongside the original embedded
2019 sharanda notice and the existing 2018 googlefonts notice; neither is replaced.

Only the six Manrope records in [the conditional map](unresolved-source-map.json)
gain this source/hash/notice binding. It corroborates the historical version OFL,
not the exact local WOFF2 acquisition/build lineage or binary equivalence.
The 89 exact-byte matches, 128 conditional records, and all 465 controlled pending
source-rights records retain their existing states. No blanket rights clearance or
new full-suite/runtime verification is claimed.

The source repository retains the applicable notices and full OFL texts. A
standalone font-directory or website export must carry those full texts and
copyright notices, together with the relevant mapping, in the distributed copy.
